Thanks — looked through the spreadsheet. Things I'd push back on / request as part of the platinum scope:
- Upgrade the 15-min panel to a 30-min hands-on workshop (we'll run a short demo + interactive Q&A). We need a guaranteed setup window (90 minutes) and AV tech at no extra charge.
- Demo pod placement: request the pod in Demo Alley within 20ft of main stage entrance (high traffic). If necessary, trade for a secondary logo placement (lounge banner) rather than lanyard exclusivity.

Priya / Emma — attaching redlines to the platinum agreement for review (contract_redlines_20261208.pdf). Key points edited inline:
- Clause 3.2 (logo placement): specify minimum pixel dimensions and two proof rounds prior to print.
- Clause 4.1 (speaking slot): changed "15-minute panel" to "30-minute workshop" and added requirement for AV technician and 90-minute setup window.
- Clause 6.4 (leads): require opt-in export within 24 hours; include scope for webhook to our SFDC ingestion endpoint.
- Clause 9.1 (force majeure / pandemic): shorten refund window for partial cancellations to 30 days (we also requested credit option).

Please review and note any commercial objections. Emma, if SummitWorks can accept these redlines we'll prep a DocuSign version.
